title: ui-preview: create Four Brutal Truths checklist
description: Create the Four Brutal Truths checklist component that presents critical validation criteria for extracted artifacts. Each truth represents a quality gate that artifacts must pass, with interactive checkboxes and validation status indicators.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL display all Four Brutal Truths as a checklist
THE SYSTEM SHALL track validation status for each truth

event_driven.trigger: WHEN user toggles a truth checkbox
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL update the validation state and recalculate overall readiness
THE SYSTEM SHALL enable the proceed action

unwanted.condition: IF user attempts to proceed without validating all truths
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow progression to next phase
unwanted.because: All quality gates must be satisfied before compilation

unwanted.condition: IF truth validation state becomes corrupted
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT show incorrect validation status
unwanted.because: Users must trust the accuracy of validation indicators

preconditions: Four Brutal Truths must be defined with clear descriptions
Checkbox state management must be initialized
Validation callback handlers must be connected
postconditions: All four truths are displayed with interactive checkboxes
Validation state is accurately tracked per truth
Overall readiness reflects collective truth validation
invariants: Exactly four truths are always displayed
Proceed action is disabled until all truths are checked

happy: Given unchecked truths, when user checks all four, then proceed button becomes enabled
Given three truths checked, when user checks the fourth, then overall readiness shows 100%
Given all truths checked, when user unchecks one, then proceed button becomes disabled
error: Given truth description fails to load, when checklist renders, then default description is shown
Given validation state fails to persist, when page reloads, then checklist resets to unchecked
Given conflicting truth states, when checklist renders, then states are reconciled to last known good state
